cohort: The study participants were near-term rat pups delivered via cesarean section and full-term pregnant rats (on gestational days 19 and 21).
finding: Diazoxide attenuates postnatal ductus arteriosus constriction and dilates a closing ductus arteriosus in fetal and neonatal rats.
gest_age: Gestational day 19, gestational day 21, and near-term
